title: Retire task time-cap presentation in JetBrains
description: Objective: remove the deprecated task time-budget presentation from JetBrains while preserving live elapsed wall-clock metrics. Deliverable: TaskCard has only its existing uncapped elapsed presentation and TaskDetailDialog has no Budget remaining KPI or budget-only empty metrics section. Scope exactly: moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/board/TaskCard.kt; moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/TaskDetailDialog.kt; moe-jetbrains/src/main/resources/messages/MoeBundle.properties; comment-only moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/util/MoeDuration.kt; new moe-jetbrains/src/test/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/TaskTimingPresentationTest.kt. Use small production-used internal presentation helpers inside the two existing UI files for headless JUnit (new APIs, not test-only copies); pass a fixed Instant and build fixtures through MoeJson.parseTask from legacy JSON so tests survive later model cleanup. Preserve the existing uncapped card visibility gate: a valid firstClaimAt is required; do not introduce a new recorded-duration-only card. Preserve recorded-duration precedence, timestamp fallback/clamping, neutral theme-aware appearance and all unrelated metrics/plan-size warnings/handoffs/critique/verification. Explicit error handling: malformed/missing timestamps remain non-throwing; ignored legacy caps never influence the rendered presentation. NOT in scope: removing model/parser fields (next dependent task), daemon enforcement/deprecation comments, metrics percentage fix, live chat/reopen limits, or new duration-display features. Exact gate from repository root on Windows: & .\moe-jetbrains\gradlew.bat -p moe-jetbrains test; exit $LASTEXITCODE. Unix equivalent: (cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test). Serialize shared Gradle runs and leave foreign dirty files untouched.
definitionOfDone: A JUnit regression with fixed time asserts TaskCard and TaskDetailDialog presentation is identical for otherwise-identical tasks with and without legacy budget JSON, and fails on the old cap/remaining behavior.

A budget-only legacy task renders neither a card timing badge nor an otherwise-empty metrics section; no cap denominator, budget utilization color, remaining KPI, warnedAt or escalatedAt presentation remains.
Existing uncapped elapsed timing, recorded-duration precedence, valid/malformed/future timestamp behavior and the valid-firstClaimAt card gate are preserved by tests.
Steps/files/wall-clock/reopens/rejects and supplemental plan-size warnings, critique, handoffs and verification still appear in the production-used presentation model when present.
The obsolete resource key and budget terminology are removed from the four scoped main-source/resource files; Task/MoeJson compatibility fields deliberately remain for the dependent cleanup.
Full JetBrains Gradle test gate passes with positive JUnit counts; regression evidence demonstrates failure of the old rendered behavior.
taskRails: Keep this slice at five changed files; use production-used test seams inside existing UI files, not a separate presenter package.
Do not remove live elapsed wall-clock metrics or change timestamp/error handling semantics.
Do not edit MetricsPanel.kt or any peer-owned source/build output.

implementationPlan.description: Retire the card cap branches inside the production-used elapsedPresentation helper and rename buildBudgetBadge/local budgetBadge terminology to elapsed-only names. The card still requires a successfully parsed metrics.firstClaimAt; if absent/blank/malformed, return null EVEN if metrics.wallClockMs is recorded or legacy budget exists. For a valid first claim, compute with the existing MoeDuration helpers: prefer recorded metrics.wallClockMs when non-null, otherwise elapsedMs(firstClaim, parsedDoneAt ?: suppliedNow), retaining timestamp fallback and clamping. Format only the elapsed duration, never a denominator/remaining amount. Use the existing uncapped neutral theme pair 0x6B7280/0xA7ABB1 unconditionally, preserving badge layout/font/foreground/border. Replace the tooltip prefix with 'Elapsed: ', retain start timestamp and used-duration information, and remove cap/warnedAt/escalatedAt input and text entirely. All final badge label/tooltip/color decisions must come from the helper consumed by the real Swing builder. In the new test file assert exact 10m fallback for firstClaim 10:00 and now 10:10; recorded 120000 yields 2m despite a different timestamp interval; valid doneAt 10:05 yields 5m; invalid/missing doneAt falls back to now; future firstClaim/done-before-first clamp to 0s; missing/blank/malformed firstClaim gives no badge even with recorded time; nonpositive recorded duration formats 0s just as before. Vary legacy budgets across absent/null/empty/malformed object/primitive, zero, negative, small, exhausted, and very large caps with warning/escalation timestamps and prove identical label/tooltip/neutral color to the uncapped task. No new recorded-duration-only card or status-specific duration feature.

completionSummary:
Retired the deprecated task time-cap presentation from the JetBrains client, keeping live elapsed wall-clock metrics.

FILES (exactly the five owned paths): TaskCard.kt, TaskDetailDialog.kt, MoeBundle.properties, MoeDuration.kt (comment-only), new test TaskTimingPresentationTest.kt. Models.kt and util/MoeJson.kt are byte-identical on purpose (git diff empty), as is every pre-existing test.

HELPER CONTRACT (new, internal, production-used — both consumed by the real Swing builders, no dead code, no separate presenter file, DTOs nested on the outer classes not in a companion):
- TaskCard.elapsedPresentation(task: Task, now: Instant): TaskCard.ElapsedPresentation?  -> label, tooltip, lightRgb, darkRgb. Null unless metrics.firstClaimAt parses (gate preserved: still null when only wallClockMs is recorded). Elapsed = metrics.wallClockMs ?: elapsedMs(firstClaim, parsedDoneAt ?: now) ?: 0. Label is the duration alone; colour is always the neutral pair 0x6B7280/0xA7ABB1; tooltip is "Elapsed: started <iso>, used <duration>".
- TaskDetailDialog.metricsPresentation(task: Task, now: Instant): MetricsPresentation? -> ordered List<KpiRow(labelKey, value)> plus CritiqueBlock, sizeWarningLines, verificationBody, reviewSummary, failedDodLines and List<HandoffBlock>. Null unless metrics / handoffs / failed DoD / critique / size warnings / verification / nonblank review summary exists — a legacy cap alone no longer opens it.
Both are pure: caller supplies `now`, neither touches MoeBundle, JBColor or any service.

REMOVED: card cap denominator, ratio-based red/yellow/green colours, "Budget: " tooltip with "of <cap>"/warned/escalated, the detail "Budget remaining" KPI and its helper, the cap-only section eligibility, the moe.metrics.budgetRemaining bundle key and all budget wording in the four scoped files (verified by a case-insensitive budget|warnedAt|escalatedAt|remaining sweep). task.budget is read nowhere in either UI file.

PRESERVED (asserted): recorded-duration precedence, timest
